what: Held-out scenes for issue #53 (plan 34 v4 §3.2). Ids, rows, bases, kinds and hashes only; the scene files are local (local/exp48-gq/scenes/heldout/<id>/, git-ignored).
author_role: held-out scene author: a sub-agent that is not the author of the generator or of the forbidden rows. It did not open kit/, packages/pit-wall/src/kit/, the kit tests, or any enforce / grader / detect file.
status: Design only. No scene was built or run in an image (no docker in the author session). Staging drafts were syntax-checked; the remote staging was exercised on a toy repository; the two staged test drafts were not run.
